results.pair_summary: Doc A (v1.1) is a refined evolution of Doc B (v1). Both define Event/WAL/Fault models for Chron-LLM. A introduces stream_id, granular tool events, and implicit causal traversal, while B defines explicit graph lifting and control policies.
results.integration_rationale: Doc A (v1.1) supersedes Doc B (v1) by streamlining the state model for Delta3 Kernel efficiency, removing explicit graph storage in favor of WAL-based causal traversal, and adding necessary stream/tool granularity. B's control logic should be verified against current runtime specs but structurally B is obsolete.
